campaign.post_title: One Smile, One World — 笑一笑，世界更美妙 (2026)
campaign.post_content:
One Smile, One World (PROJECT 002) is Malaysia's first national movement inviting students to recall the smile of someone they are grateful for — a parent, teacher, or anyone who made a difference — draw it, and share one heartfelt sentence.

10,000 Smiles. One Ecosystem. · 笑一笑，世界更美妙

In school (~1 hour)

  1. Warm-up — mentor emotional story (5 min)
  2. Guided awareness — recall a grateful person's smile (60 sec)
  3. Drawing — ~35 min
  4. Heartfelt message on artwork (5 min)
  5. Mentor sharing — emotional management & life wisdom (10 min)
  6. Wrap-up — collect art, submission code for parent, gift pack, photo

After school (parents)

Register on Creative Wings, enter the submission code from school, confirm the student's name, and complete registration. School sponsor coupon = free; public registration = RM 15.

Year-end showcase

10,000 Smiles Showcase — national gallery exhibition targeted November 2026. Top smiles curated for the gallery wall.

Hashtag: #OneSmileOneWorld · Organiser: Creative Wings · creativewings.asia

faq.question: Who can join One Smile, One World?
faq.answer: Primary and secondary students via participating schools nationwide. Adults and university students may register under the Public category. Parents complete online registration after the in-school session using the submission code from school.

faq.question: What is a submission code?
faq.answer: A 13-digit code from your school PIC, e.g. 0020600100001 (campaign 002 + month + school + sequence). Parents enter this code in My Account → Link submission code.

faq.question: Is there a fee?
faq.answer: Students from sponsor schools register free using the school WooCommerce coupon. Public or non-sponsored participants pay RM 15 on checkout.

faq.question: What do I submit?
faq.answer: Your smiling-face artwork is uploaded at school by the PIC. Online you confirm the name, add your heartfelt message, and receive a digital participation certificate after completion.

faq.question: When is the national gallery?
faq.answer: The 10,000 Smiles Showcase is targeted for November 2026. Top artworks may be featured on the national gallery wall.

faq.question: Can I change my artwork after parent registration?
faq.answer: Before a parent claims your code, the school PIC can amend the submission using the same code at the staff upload link. After claim, contact Creative Wings admin for changes.

faq.question: Why a “Smiling Face”?
faq.answer:
A smile is simple — but it can carry a powerful message.

For children and young people, drawing a smiling face provides a simple and enjoyable way to express happiness, appreciation, care and positive emotions through their own creativity.

In a world where young people increasingly communicate through screens and digital images, we invite them to pause, observe and create something with their own hands.

Each hand-drawn smile is therefore more than a picture.
It is a small expression of human connection, kindness and hope.

One smile may be small. Together, thousands of smiles can tell a bigger story about the world we hope to create.

faq.question: Why is there a RM15 participation contribution?
faq.answer:
The RM15 contribution per smiling face helps us turn an individual drawing into part of a shared learning and community experience.

Each submission includes:

  • One original smiling-face drawing
  • A personal note from the participant
  • Digital participation / submission through the Creative Wings platform
  • Inclusion in the collective “Smiling Face” showcase
  • Opportunity for selected works to be featured in the year-end physical exhibition, subject to venue and programme arrangements

The contribution also helps support the practical costs of organising the initiative — including platform administration, documentation, curation, exhibition preparation and programme coordination.

We hope every RM15 contribution is not viewed simply as a fee to enter a drawing activity, but as a small contribution towards creating a meaningful platform where young talents can express themselves, connect with others and be part of something bigger.

faq.question: After the smiling face is drawn, what is the IMPACT?
faq.answer:
The drawing is only the beginning.
We hope the initiative creates impact at three levels:

😊 INDIVIDUAL — Minds & Hearts

Young participants have an opportunity to pause, reflect and express positive emotions through art.
They practise creativity, self-expression, appreciation and communication — sometimes without needing many words.

🤝 COMMUNITY — Connecting People

Each smiling face becomes part of a larger collection of smiles from different children, schools, families and communities.
When these individual drawings come together, they create a visual reminder that we may be different, but positive human values can connect us.

🌏 SOCIETY — A Shared Message

At the year-end showcase, individual drawings can become a collective story — shared with students, parents, teachers, partners and the wider community.
Through this journey, Art + Education + Community Participation can become a practical way to introduce young people to values connected with SDG and ESG — caring for people, communities and the world we share.

From One Smile to Shared Impact

Draw a smile → Express a feeling → Share a message → Connect with others → Create positive impact.

We believe meaningful change does not always begin with something big.
Sometimes, it begins with one child, one drawing and one smile.
